claims.claim: The University of Nottingham ran a six-week randomized trial with 117 adults who had knee osteoarthritis testing daily inulin.
claims.episode_span: Researchers at the University of Nottingham conducted the six-week INSPIRE trial involving 117 adults diagnosed with knee osteoarthritis.
claims.source_title: A simple daily fiber supplement reduced arthritis pain and improved strength
claims.supporting_quote: To investigate these effects, the researchers conducted the INSPIRE trial, a six-week randomized controlled study involving 117 adults with knee osteoarthritis.

claims.claim: EEG recordings from roughly 400 autistic and neurotypical children showed that face-specific electrical patterns grew more distinct with age only in the neurotypical group.
claims.episode_span: Researchers at Yale and the University of Houston analyzed full-scalp EEG data from approximately 400 children in the Autism Biomarkers Consortium for Clinical Trials.
claims.source_title: The autistic brain processes faces differently than scientists thought
claims.supporting_quote: They also identified a striking difference in development: In neurotypical children, the brain's response to faces became more specialized with age, while autistic children did not show the same pattern.

claims.claim: McGill University researchers showed T cells sense tissue stiffness through surface receptors linking the cytoskeleton to the extracellular matrix.
claims.episode_span: McGill University researchers traced the pathway to surface receptors that connect the T-cell cytoskeleton to the surrounding extracellular matrix, converting mechanical force into changes in gene expression that favor memory formation.
claims.source_title: Scientists discover the immune system’s hidden sense of touch
claims.supporting_quote: Researchers found that T cells can actually sense how stiff their surrounding tissues are, using these physical signals to help determine whether they develop into long-lasting memory cells that protect against future infections.
